questions.stem: Which of the following contract rights can generally be assigned?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The right to receive personal services.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The right to receive a sum of money.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The right of an insured to coverage under a fire insurance policy.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A right whose assignment is prohibited by statute.

questions.explanation:
In general, any contract right and duty may be assigned. However, there are certain reasons why a contract right might not be assignable. Assignment may be prohibited by the express language of the contract itself or by statute ("A right whose assignment is prohibited by statute.").

The most common reason for prohibiting the assignment of a contract is that it will materially change the rights or duties of a party to the contract. In the case of a fire insurance policy, the insurer sets the rates based on its risk assessment of the particular insured party and its property ("The right of an insured to coverage under a fire insurance policy."). Assigning the insurance contract to a different party with a higher risk profile (no fire sprinkler system) would materially change the insurance company's exposure.

Alternatively, the duties and obligations for a typical contract involving the right to receive a sum of money (promissory note) are not materially affected by who performs them.

("The right to receive personal services.") Personal services are unique and therefore can't be assigned. For instance, a celebrity singer under contract to perform a concert can't assign another singer to perform the concert instead.
questions.explanationJa: 一般に、契約上の権利・義務は譲渡できる。ただし、契約自体の明示の条項や法律で譲渡が禁止されている場合、または譲渡によって相手方の権利・義務が実質的に変わる場合には譲渡できない。金銭の支払いを受ける権利（約束手形など）は、誰が権利者であっても相手方の義務は実質的に変わらないため、譲渡できる。これに対し、火災保険は保険者が特定の被保険者とその財産のリスクを評価して保険料を設定しているため、別の者に譲渡するとリスクが実質的に変わる。また、人的役務は個人に固有のものなので、その提供を受ける権利は譲渡できない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.1

questions.stem:
Where the parties have entered into a written contract intended as the final expression of their agreement, which of the following agreements will be admitted into evidence because they are not prohibited by the parol evidence rule?
Subsequent oral agreements | Prior written agreements

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes | Yes

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes | No

choices.label: C
choices.text: No | Yes

choices.label: D
choices.text: No | No

questions.explanation:
The parol evidence rule (PER) prohibits the use of oral or written evidence that contradicts the terms of a written contract. The PER applies even if a contract is not required to be in writing under the statute of frauds. The PER bars from evidence in a lawsuit any prior or contemporaneous (concurrent) oral or written agreements that contradict the final written contract.

The PER does not prevent the use of evidence about:

Subsequent oral or written agreements to modify a contract,

Fraud in the execution of a written contract, or

Clarification of ambiguous or missing terms in a signed, written contract.

The PER exists because courts assume that a written, signed contract is the complete and final expression of the parties' agreement. Therefore, the integrity of written contracts is maintained because parties in a legal dispute are prevented from effectively rewriting a contract via court testimony. After the contract is signed, the parties can agree to modify it as they deem necessary, and testimony about those subsequent agreements may be admitted as evidence.
questions.explanationJa: 口頭証拠排除法則（parol evidence rule）は、当事者の最終的な合意として作成された書面契約と矛盾する、それ以前または同時の口頭・書面の合意を証拠から排除するものである。この法則は、書面契約が詐欺防止法上書面を要しない契約であっても適用される。一方、契約締結後に行われた口頭・書面の変更合意は、この法則によって排除されない。したがって、事後の口頭合意は証拠として認められるが、事前の書面合意は認められない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.2

questions.stem: Which of the following transactions correctly illustrates the doctrine of substantial performance?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Blair ordered a dozen blue chairs from Kyle, but Kyle delivered a dozen red chairs.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Leslie painted an entire room but failed to put the electrical outlet covers back on.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A contract required hair styling to be done to Toby's satisfaction, but Toby was, in good faith, dissatisfied with the completed result.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A dentist competently completed the extraction of Lee's tooth but mistakenly pulled the wrong one.

questions.explanation:
Under the doctrine of substantial performance, when a party completes the main purpose of the contract (paints a room) then the party's contractual duty is considered to be complete even though minor details are unfinished (outlet covers not reinstalled). This doctrine prevents parties from withholding payment by claiming breach of contract for minor technicalities.

In contracts for specific services such as hair styling, there is no substantial performance when the recipient has a good faith belief that the services have not been satisfactorily performed ("A contract required hair styling to be done to Toby's satisfaction, b…"). In that case the recipient is not obligated to pay even though the main purpose of the contract (hair styling) has been performed. Assessing a satisfactory hair styling requires more subjective judgment than assessing the completion of a painted room.

("Blair ordered a dozen blue chairs from Kyle, but Kyle delivered a doz…") The doctrine of substantial performance does not apply to the sale of goods. Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code specifies that the perfect tender rule, which requires that the purchased goods must conform exactly to the specifications in the contract.

("A dentist competently completed the extraction of Lee's tooth but mis…") Extracting the wrong tooth is not substantial performance. The patient is not obligated to pay for dental services that may be considered malpractice.
questions.explanationJa: 実質的履行の法理とは、当事者が契約の主たる目的を完了していれば、細部が未完成であっても契約上の義務は履行されたものとみなすものである。部屋全体を塗装したがコンセントのカバーを付け直さなかった場合は、主目的である塗装が完了しているので実質的履行に当たる。満足を条件とする美容のような役務では、受け手が誠実に不満足と判断すれば実質的履行は成立しない。物品売買には実質的履行の法理は適用されず、UCC第2編の完全提供原則（perfect tender rule）により契約どおりの物品が求められる。また、誤った歯を抜くことは実質的履行に当たらない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.3

questions.stem: In June, Mullin, a general contractor, contracted with a town to renovate the town square. The town council wanted the project done quickly and the parties placed a clause in the contract that for each day the project extended beyond 90 working days, Mullin would forfeit $100 of the contract price. In August, Mullin took a three-week vacation. The project was completed in October, 120 working days after it was begun. What type of damages may the town recover from Mullin?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Punitive damages because taking a vacation in the middle of the project was irresponsible.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Compensatory damages because of the delay in completing the project.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Liquidated damages because of the $100 forfeiture clause in the contract.

choices.label: D
choices.text: No damages because Mullin completed performance.

questions.explanation:
When a contract is breached, the nonbreaching party is usually awarded compensatory damages (monetary damages) for direct or actual losses incurred. In place of compensatory damages, and for convenience, the parties may include in the contract a provision for liquidated damages ("Compensatory damages because of the delay in completing the project.").

The liquidated damages amount represents the parties' reasonable estimate of monetary damages due to a breach (late completion of the contract). Courts generally don't override these determinations, especially when both parties appear to have equal bargaining power.

In this scenario, Mullin and the town council determined that $100 for every day Mullin is late is an appropriate amount for liquidated damages. Since this is part of the contract, the town is entitled to the liquidated damages, even though Mullin eventually completed performance of the contract ("No damages because Mullin completed performance.").

("Punitive damages because taking a vacation in the middle of the proje…") Punitive damages are not awarded for breach of contract. In fact, if the liquidated damages are excessive, they are considered punitive in nature (ie, penalty) and a court will not enforce them. However, there is nothing in this scenario to indicate the $100 per day liquidated damages are excessive.
questions.explanationJa: 契約違反があった場合、通常は実際の損失に対する補償的損害賠償が認められるが、当事者は便宜のため、これに代えて損害賠償額の予定（liquidated damages）を契約に定めることができる。予定額は違反（本問では完成の遅延）による損害の合理的な見積もりであり、特に交渉力が対等な当事者間で定めたものであれば、裁判所は通常これを覆さない。本問では、90作業日を超えた1日ごとに$100を契約代金から差し引く条項があるため、Mullinが最終的に履行を完了していても、町は予定された損害賠償を受け取れる。契約違反に懲罰的損害賠償は認められず、本問では$100という額が過大で違約罰に当たる事情もない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.4

questions.stem: One of the criteria for a valid assignment of a sales contract to a third party is that the assignment must

choices.label: A
choices.text: Not materially increase the other party's risk or duty.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Not be revocable by the assignor.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Be supported by adequate consideration from the assignee.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Be in writing and signed by the assignor.

questions.explanation:
Generally, any contract right and duty may be assigned to a third party. However, there are certain reasons why a contract right might not be assignable. The most common reason for prohibiting the assignment of a contract, including a sales contract, is that it will materially change the rights or duties of a party to the contract.

For instance, A contracts to sell goods to B. As part of the sale, A promises free delivery. B's place of delivery is only 10 miles from A. Generally, B can transfer the sales contract to another party, so long as the delivery charges for A are not materially more than they would be for delivery to B. The assignment would be invalid if B transferred the contract to someone 5,000 miles away.

("Not be revocable by the assignor.") The person assigning the contract to a third party has the option to make the assignment revocable. However, doing so does not invalidate the assignment.

("Be supported by adequate consideration from the assignee.") An assignment can be made as part of a gift or inheritance, both of which do not have consideration as part of the assignment.

("Be in writing and signed by the assignor.") The Statute of Frauds applies to sales contracts of $500 or more. Therefore, some sales contract assignments do not need to be in writing or signed by the assignor.
questions.explanationJa: 一般に、契約上の権利・義務は第三者に譲渡できるが、譲渡によって相手方の権利・義務が実質的に変わる場合には譲渡できない。たとえば、売主が無料配送を約束した売買契約で、買主が10マイル先ではなく5,000マイル先の者に契約を譲渡すれば、売主の負担が大きく増えるため譲渡は無効となる。したがって、有効な譲渡の要件の一つは、相手方のリスクや義務を実質的に増加させないことである。譲渡は撤回可能なものであっても無効にならず、贈与や相続のように対価のない譲渡もあり得る。また、すべての譲渡が書面と譲渡人の署名を要するわけではない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.5

questions.stem: The statute of limitations for an alleged breach of contract

choices.label: A
choices.text: Does not apply if the contract was oral.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Requires that a lawsuit be commenced and a judgment rendered within a prescribed period of time.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Is determined on a case-by-case basis.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Generally commences on the date of the breach.

questions.explanation:
A statute of limitations (SOL) is a law that establishes the time period during which a lawsuit can be filed. In contract law, the SOL time period starts when the contract is breached. Once the SOL period has expired, the injured party is prohibited from suing the breaching party for damages. However, if the lawsuit commences (filed with a court) during the SOL period, a judgment can be rendered after the SOL period expires ("Requires that a lawsuit be commenced and a judgment rendered within a…").

The purpose of an SOL is to require the parties to bring a lawsuit within a reasonable time frame after the event that precipitated it. Otherwise, evidence might be lost over time and leave the defendant unable to effectively refute the claims. The SOL time period for breach of contract varies by state but generally is 4 to 6 years.

("Does not apply if the contract was oral.") The SOL applies to all contracts whether written or oral. Issues involving the validity of oral contracts are governed by the statute of frauds.

("Is determined on a case-by-case basis.") The SOL is a general rule established by law. It is not determined on a case-by-case basis.
questions.explanationJa: 出訴期限（statute of limitations）は訴訟を提起できる期間を定める法律であり、契約法では、その期間は契約違反の時点から起算される。期間が経過すると、被害を受けた当事者は損害賠償を求めて訴えることができなくなるが、期間内に訴訟を提起していれば、判決が期間経過後に出されても差し支えない。出訴期限は書面か口頭かを問わずすべての契約に適用され（口頭契約の有効性は詐欺防止法の問題である）、個別の事案ごとに決まるものではなく法律で一般的に定められている。契約違反についての期間は州により異なるが、一般に4〜6年である。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.6

questions.stem: Contracts to purchase which of the following cannot be assigned without consent of the other party to the contract?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Vehicles.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Real estate.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Businesses.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Personal services.

questions.explanation:
a contract for personal services cannot be assigned because the personal services are unique. Assigning them materially alters the contract.

As an example, a celebrity singer under contract to perform a concert cannot assign his singing duties to another singer. Transferring this performance duty materially alters the contract and is detrimental to the other party to the contract (eg, concert promoter). The concert promoter who hired the original singer did so based on that singer's particular singing style, performance skills, etc. Any other singer, no matter how skilled, would not be the same.

("Vehicles." / "Real estate." / "Businesses.") The right to purchase general items such as a vehicle, real estate, or a business is assignable. An assignment of that right does not materially change the contract and therefore can be assigned. For instance, if Alex has an option to buy a vehicle from Charlie, Alex can transfer the option to Blair without materially affecting the contract with Charlie. If Blair exercises the option, Charlie will still sell the vehicle; however, the sale will be to Blair, not to Alex.
questions.explanationJa: 人的役務の契約は、その役務が個人に固有のものであり、譲渡すると契約内容が実質的に変わってしまうため、相手方の同意なしには譲渡できない。たとえば、コンサートに出演する契約をした有名歌手は、歌唱の義務を別の歌手に譲ることはできない。主催者はその歌手の歌い方や技量を前提に契約しているからである。一方、車両、不動産、事業を購入する権利のような一般的な権利は、譲渡しても契約内容が実質的に変わらないため譲渡できる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.7

questions.stem: Master Mfg., Inc., contracted with Accur Computer Repair Corp. to maintain Master's computer system. Master's manufacturing process depends on its computer system operating properly at all times. A liquidated damages clause in the contract provided that Accur pay $1,000 to Master for each day that Accur was late responding to a service request. On January 12, Accur was notified that Master's computer system failed. Accur did not respond to Master's service request until January 15. If Master sues Accur under the liquidated damage provision of the contract, Master will

choices.label: A
choices.text: Win, unless the liquidated damage provision is determined to be a penalty.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Win, because under all circumstances a liquidated damage provision is determined to be a penalty.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Lose, because Accur's breach was not material.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Lose, because liquidated damage provisions violate public policy.

questions.explanation:
In place of compensatory damages, and for convenience, the parties may include a provision for liquidated damages in the contract. The liquidated damages amount represents the parties' reasonable estimate of monetary damages due to a breach. If the liquidated damages are excessive, they are considered punitive in nature (ie, a penalty). Because punitive damages are not awarded for breach of contract, a court will not enforce liquidated damages that are excessive and are effectively a penalty.

("Win, because under all circumstances a liquidated damage provision is…" / "Lose, because Accur's breach was not material.") There is no definitive way to determine if liquidated damages are excessive and a penalty, or not. This is a fact-based determination. In this scenario, there is nothing to indicate the liquidated damages are excessive or a penalty. In fact, Master Mfg., Inc., and Accur Computer Repair Corp. thought failing to respond to a service call was important enough (material) that they specifically agreed to the $1,000-per-day liquidated damages. Courts generally do not override these determinations, especially when both parties appear to have equal bargaining power.

("Lose, because liquidated damage provisions violate public policy.") Assuming they are not excessive, liquidated damages are a reasonable way to settle breaches of contract and therefore are not a violation of public policy.
questions.explanationJa: 当事者は、補償的損害賠償に代えて損害賠償額の予定を契約に定めることができ、予定額は違反による損害についての当事者の合理的な見積もりを表す。予定額が過大であれば懲罰的な違約罰とみなされ、契約違反に懲罰的損害賠償は認められないため、裁判所はその条項を執行しない。違約罰に当たるかどうかは事実に基づいて判断され、すべての予定条項が違約罰になるわけではない。本問では過大であることを示す事情はなく、当事者はサービス要請への対応遅れを重要視して1日$1,000の予定を合意しているので、違約罰と判断されない限りMasterが勝訴する。過大でない予定賠償は公序に反するものでもない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.8

questions.stem: Rogers and Lennon entered into a written computer consulting agreement that required Lennon to provide certain weekly reports to Rogers. The agreement also stated that Lennon would provide the computer equipment necessary to perform the services, and that Rogers' computer would not be used. As the parties were executing the agreement, they orally agreed that Lennon could use Rogers' computer. After executing the agreement, Rogers and Lennon orally agreed that Lennon would report on a monthly, rather than weekly, basis. The parties now disagree on Lennon's right to use Rogers' computer and how often Lennon must report to Rogers. In the event of a lawsuit between the parties, the parol evidence rule will

choices.label: A
choices.text: Not apply to any of the parties' agreements because the consulting agreement did not have to be in writing.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Not prevent Lennon from proving the parties' oral agreement that Lennon could use Rogers' computer.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Not prevent the admission into evidence of testimony regarding Lennon's right to report on a monthly basis.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Not apply to the parties' agreement to allow Lennon to use Rogers' computer because it was contemporaneous with the written agreement.

questions.explanation:
Contracts subject to the statute of frauds

Sale of Goods worth $500 or more

Real estate sales

Over One year required to perform contract

Suretyship (guarantee debts of others)

Statements in consideration of marriage

Executor (promise to pay estate's debts from executor's personal funds)

Mnemonic: GROSSE

The PER does not prevent the use of evidence about subsequent oral or written modifications to a contract (eg, agreeing to monthly, rather than weekly, reporting). The PER exists because courts assume that a written, signed contract is the complete and final expression of the parties' agreement. Therefore, the integrity of written contracts is maintained because parties in a legal dispute are prevented from effectively rewriting a contract via court testimony.

("Not apply to any of the parties' agreements because the consulting ag…") In this scenario, the computer consulting agreement was not required to be in writing because it did not fall within any of the statute of frauds (SOF) contract types. The PER applies even if a contract is not required to be in writing under the SOF.

("Not prevent Lennon from proving the parties' oral agreement that Lenn…" / "Not apply to the parties' agreement to allow Lennon to use Rogers' co…") The oral agreement to allow Lennon to use Rogers' computer was made contemporaneously with the signing of the contract and contradicts the terms of the signed, written contract. Therefore, the PER applies to this oral agreement and prevents it from being used as evidence in a lawsuit about the written contract.
questions.explanationJa: 口頭証拠排除法則（parol evidence rule）は、最終的な書面契約と矛盾する、それ以前または同時の合意を証拠から排除するものであり、詐欺防止法上書面を要しない契約（本問のコンサルティング契約のように、物品売買や不動産、1年超の契約などに当たらないもの）にも適用される。LennonがRogersのコンピュータを使用できるという口頭合意は、契約の締結と同時に行われ、書面契約の条項と矛盾するため、この法則により証拠から排除される。一方、締結後に行われた月次報告への変更の口頭合意は事後の変更なので、この法則によって証拠から排除されない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.9

questions.stem: Pierce owed Duke $3,000. Pierce contracted with Lodge to paint Lodge's house and Lodge agreed to pay Duke $3,000 to satisfy Pierce's debt. Pierce painted Lodge's house but Lodge did not pay Duke the $3,000. In a lawsuit by Duke against Pierce and Lodge, who will be liable to Duke?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Pierce only.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Lodge only.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Both Pierce and Lodge.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Neither Pierce nor Lodge.

questions.explanation: Duke is a third-party beneficiary of the contract between Pierce and Lodge and as such can "stand in the shoes" of Pierce and enforce the agreement that Lodge pay Duke the $3,000. In addition, Pierce is liable to Duke because of Pierce's original $3,000 obligation.
questions.explanationJa: Dukeは、PierceとLodgeの間の契約の第三受益者であり、Pierceの立場に立って、LodgeがDukeに$3,000を支払うという合意を履行するよう求めることができる。また、Pierceは、もともとDukeに対して$3,000の債務を負っているため、その債務についてDukeに責任を負い続ける。したがって、PierceとLodgeの両方がDukeに対して責任を負う。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.10

questions.stem: For which of the following contracts will a court generally grant the remedy of specific performance?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A contract for the sale of a patent.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A contract of employment.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A contract for the sale of fungible goods.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A contract for the sale of stock that is traded on a national stock exchange.

questions.explanation:
when the subject matter of the contract is unique and monetary damages will not suffice, a court may award specific performance to the injured party.

A patent, by definition, is a unique product or process. In a contract for the sale of a patent, measuring the monetary damages the purchaser would incur for not being able to use the patent would be difficult, if not impossible. Therefore, the most appropriate remedy is the specific performance of making the breaching party (ie, seller) sell the patent to the injured party (ie, purchaser).

("A contract of employment.") Specific performance is never a remedy for breach of an employment contract. Otherwise, a breaching party would be forced to work with or for the other party against the breaching party's will.

("A contract for the sale of fungible goods.") Fungible goods (eg, commodities) are not unique. Therefore, compensatory damages are the most appropriate remedy for a breach of contract for fungible goods.

("A contract for the sale of stock that is traded on a national stock e…") Compensatory damages are the most appropriate remedy for a breach of contract for the sale of a publicly traded stock. Once compensated, the injured party can purchase replacement shares on the national exchange.
questions.explanationJa: 契約の目的物が唯一無二のもので金銭賠償では十分でない場合、裁判所は特定履行を命じることがある。特許は定義上、唯一の製品や製法であり、買主が特許を使えないことによる損害を金銭で測ることは困難なので、売主に特許の売却を命じる特定履行が最も適切な救済となる。雇用契約では、意思に反して働かせることになるため特定履行は認められない。代替可能な物品（商品）や全国証券取引所で取引される株式は唯一のものではなく、補償的損害賠償を受ければ代わりのものを購入できるため、特定履行は認められない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.11

questions.stem: Under a personal services contract, which of the following circumstances will cause the discharge of a party's duties?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Death of the party who is to receive the services.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Cost of performing the services has doubled.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Bankruptcy of the party who is to receive the services.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Illegality of the services to be performed.

questions.explanation:
Some PSCs are discharged because their subject matter (services to be performed) becomes illegal. The illegality must occur after the contract is formed for the contract to be discharged.

For example, a doctor enters into a PSC with a patient to administer a new, experimental medical procedure. If the U.S. Food and Drug Administration later rules that the procedure should not be performed, the contract is discharged because that service (medical procedure) is now illegal.

("Death of the party who is to receive the services." / "Bankruptcy of the party who is to receive the services.") A PSC will not be discharged just because the party receiving the services is unable to receive them or becomes bankrupt. For example, an actress who contracts with a producer to act in the producer's movie is still obligated to perform in the movie if the producer dies or becomes bankrupt.

("Cost of performing the services has doubled.") Cost increases are not a reason to discharge a contract.
questions.explanationJa: 人的役務契約は、その目的である役務が違法となった場合に履行義務が免除される。ただし、違法となるのは契約成立後でなければならない。たとえば、医師が患者に実験的な医療処置を行う契約を結んだ後、FDAがその処置を行ってはならないと判断した場合、契約は消滅する。役務を受ける側が死亡したり破産したりしただけでは契約は消滅せず、履行にかかる費用が2倍になったというコストの増加も契約を免除する理由にならない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.12

questions.stem: Card communicated an offer to sell Card's stereo to Bend for $250. Which of the following statements is correct regarding the effect of the communication of the offer?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Bend should immediately accept or reject the offer to avoid liability to Card.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Card is not obligated to sell the stereo to Bend until Bend accepts the offer.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Card is required to mitigate any loss Card would sustain in the event Bend rejects the offer.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Bend may not reject the offer for a reasonable period of time.

questions.explanation:
Once Bend accepts the exact terms of Card's offer, there is a binding contract between the two. Card will be obligated to sell the stereo to Bend and Bend will be obligated to pay Card $250 for it.

("Bend should immediately accept or reject the offer to avoid liability…" / "Bend may not reject the offer for a reasonable period of time.") An offer may terminate within the specific time stated in the offer. If the offer does not contain a specific time limit, then it lapses after a reasonable time. However, an offer never becomes a binding contract just because the offeree failed to immediately respond. Also, there is no requirement that an offeree must wait a reasonable time before rejecting an offer.

("Card is required to mitigate any loss Card would sustain in the event…") Since there is only an outstanding offer, there are no contractual obligations between the parties, including any obligation to mitigate losses.
questions.explanationJa: Cardの申込みは、Bendがその条件どおりに承諾したときに初めて拘束力のある契約となり、その時点でCardは$250でステレオを売る義務を負う。したがって、Bendが承諾するまでCardに売却義務はない。申込みは定められた期間の経過、または期間の定めがなければ合理的な期間の経過によって失効するが、被申込者が直ちに応答しなかったからといって契約が成立することはなく、拒絶する前に合理的な期間待たなければならないという要件もない。また、申込みがあるだけで契約関係は存在しないため、損失を軽減する義務も生じない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.13

questions.stem: Which of the following circumstances generally will cause a discharge of contractual duties by operation of law?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Novation.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Accord and satisfaction.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Anticipatory repudiation.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Impossibility of performance.

questions.explanation:
Impossibility of performance occurs when the objective of the contract becomes impossible to accomplish. The impossibility must occur after the contract is formed and before performance. When impossibility of performance happens, there is no reason to continue the contract, and courts will not enforce it. For instance, there is no reason to enforce a painting contract if the building burns down before it can be painted.

("Novation.") When there is a novation, the original parties agree to substitute a 3rd party for one of the original parties. The duties of the departing party are discharged by the substitution agreement, not by operation of law.

("Accord and satisfaction.") In accord and satisfaction, the original parties agree to substitute one duty for another. The original duty is discharged when the substituted duty is completed. However, the original duty is not discharged by operation of law; instead, it is discharged pursuant to the agreement between the parties.

("Anticipatory repudiation.") Anticipatory repudiation concerns breach of a contract, not the discharge of a contractual duty. It occurs when a party indicates that it will be unable to perform its contractual duty. The duty is not discharged; rather, the other party has legal options because of the breach (ie, sue now or wait to sue).
questions.explanationJa: 履行不能は、契約成立後かつ履行前に契約の目的の達成が不可能となった場合に生じ、契約を継続する理由がなくなるため、裁判所は契約を執行しない（例：塗装前に建物が焼失した塗装契約）。これは法の作用による義務の免除である。更改（novation）は当事者の一方を第三者に置き換える合意であり、代物弁済（accord and satisfaction）は義務を別の義務に置き換える合意であって、いずれも当事者間の合意に基づいて義務が消滅するもので、法の作用によるものではない。履行期前の履行拒絶（anticipatory repudiation）は契約違反の問題であり、義務の免除ではない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.14

questions.stem:
Generally, which of the following contract rights are assignable?
Option contract rights | Malpractice insurance policy rights

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes | Yes

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes | No

choices.label: C
choices.text: No | Yes

choices.label: D
choices.text: No | No

questions.explanation:
In the case of malpractice insurance (professional liability insurance), the insurer sets the rates based on its risk assessment of the particular insured party. Assigning the insurance contract to a different party with a higher risk profile would materially change the insurance company's exposure.

For instance, ABC Accounting limits its practice to simple bookkeeping services and has a professional liability insurance policy covering its practice. ABC cannot transfer this policy to XYZ Accounting, which specializes in providing tax opinions for highly speculative tax shelters.

Alternatively, the duties and obligations for a typical option contract are not materially affected by who performs them. If Alex has an option to buy stock in a company, Alex can transfer the option to Blair without materially affecting the rights and duties of the company. If the option is exercised, the company will still sell the stock; however, the sale will be to Blair, not Alex.
questions.explanationJa: 職業賠償責任保険（malpractice insurance）では、保険者が特定の被保険者のリスク評価に基づいて保険料を設定しているため、リスクの高い別の者に譲渡すると保険会社の負担が実質的に変わってしまい、譲渡できない。たとえば、簡単な記帳業務に限定している事務所の保険を、投機的なタックスシェルターの意見書を専門とする事務所に移すことはできない。一方、オプション契約では誰が権利を行使しても相手方の権利・義務は実質的に変わらないため、譲渡できる。したがって、オプション契約上の権利は譲渡可能で、職業賠償責任保険上の権利は譲渡できない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.15

questions.stem: Ferco, Inc. claims to be a creditor beneficiary of a contract between Bell and Allied Industries, Inc. Allied is indebted to Ferco. The contract between Bell and Allied provides that Bell is to purchase certain goods from Allied and pay the purchase price directly to Ferco until Allied's obligation is satisfied. Without justification, Bell failed to pay Ferco and Ferco sued Bell. Ferco will

choices.label: A
choices.text: Not prevail, because Ferco can sue only Allied.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Not prevail, because Ferco must sue both Allied and Bell.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Prevail, because Ferco was an intended beneficiary of the contract between Allied and Bell.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Prevail, provided Ferco was aware of the contract between Bell and Allied at the time the contract was entered into.

questions.explanation:
A creditor beneficiary (Ferco, Inc.) is a type of intended beneficiary who receives benefits from the contract to settle a debt owed to it by one of the signing parties. If the contract is breached, the creditor beneficiary can sue either party (Bell and/or Allied Industries, Inc.) and will prevail in that lawsuit ("Not prevail, because Ferco can sue only Allied." / "Not prevail, because Ferco must sue both Allied and Bell.").

In this scenario, Ferco is an intended creditor beneficiary of the purchase contract between Allied and Bell. Under the contract, Bell is obligated to send payments to Ferco to pay off a debt that Allied owes Ferco. Ferco sues Bell for failing to make the payments, and Ferco will prevail. In addition, Ferco can sue Allied because Allied is still indebted to Ferco.

("Prevail, provided Ferco was aware of the contract between Bell and Al…") An intended beneficiary is entitled to benefits from a contract regardless of whether the beneficiary knew of the contract when it was entered into.
questions.explanationJa: 債権者受益者（creditor beneficiary）とは、契約当事者の一方が自分に負っている債務の弁済として契約上の利益を受ける意図された受益者である。本問では、BellがAlliedから商品を購入し、その代金をAlliedのFercoに対する債務の弁済としてFercoに直接支払う契約になっているので、Fercoは意図された債権者受益者に当たる。契約が違反された場合、債権者受益者はどちらの当事者を訴えることもでき、FercoはBellに対する訴訟で勝訴する（Alliedもなお債務を負っているので訴えられる）。意図された受益者は、契約締結時にその契約を知っていたかどうかにかかわらず利益を受ける権利がある。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.16

questions.stem: To cancel a contract and to restore the parties to their original positions before the contract, the parties should execute a

choices.label: A
choices.text: Novation.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Release.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Rescission.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Revocation.

questions.explanation:
To cancel a contract and restore the parties to their original positions before the contract was made, the parties should enter into a rescission. In a sense, it is as if the contract never existed.

("Novation.") Novation is the act of substituting a new party for an original party in an existing contractual arrangement.

("Release.") Release is the discharge of a party from any remaining obligations under a contract. In this case, the contract ends with part of the contractual duties having been performed; the parties are not restored to their original positions.

("Revocation.") Revocation is the act of withdrawing an offer during the contract negotiation process.
questions.explanationJa: 契約を取り消し、当事者を契約前の状態に戻すには、合意解除（rescission）を行う。これにより、契約は事実上存在しなかったのと同じ状態になる。更改（novation）は既存の契約の当事者を新しい当事者に置き換えるものであり、免除（release）は残りの義務から当事者を解放するもので、すでに一部履行された状態で終わるため原状には戻らない。撤回（revocation）は契約交渉の過程で申込みを取り下げる行為である。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.17

questions.stem: A CPA sued a former client for nonpayment of the final bill. Although happy with the CPA's performance of services, the client claimed that the CPA is not entitled to the final bill payment because the contract between the client and the CPA failed to meet the Statute of Frauds. The client argues that the contract allowed up to 15 months for the CPA to complete the work, the contract price was well over $5,000, and though the client sent signed checks to the CPA, the client did not sign the contract. Which of the following statements about this situation is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The Statute of Frauds does not apply, allowing enforcement of the contract terms.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The Statute of Frauds does not apply, preventing enforcement of the contract terms.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The Statute of Frauds does apply, and the requirements are not satisfied, thereby preventing enforcement of the contract terms.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The Statute of Frauds does apply, but the requirements are satisfied by the client's signing of the checks, allowing enforcement of the contract terms.

questions.explanation:
In this scenario, the SOF may seem to apply because the contract appears to fall within the one-year duration category, allowing up to 15 months for completion. However, the contract does not fall within the SOF over-one-year category because it can end in less than one year. This is true even though the contract might last for more than one year (ie, up to 15 months). Since the other SOF categories ($500 sale of goods, real estate) do not apply, the SOF does not apply and the contract terms can be enforced.

("The Statute of Frauds does not apply, preventing enforcement of the c…") When the SOF does not apply, enforcement of the terms of an unwritten contract is allowed, not prevented.

("The Statute of Frauds does apply, and the requirements are not satisf…" / "The Statute of Frauds does apply, but the requirements are satisfied…") Since the SOF does not apply (for the reasons stated above), it is not necessary to consider the additional requirement that the contract be signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought (the client).
questions.explanationJa: 契約が完了まで最大15か月を認めていることから、詐欺防止法の「1年を超える契約」に当たるように見える。しかし、この類型に当たるのは1年以内に履行を完了できない契約であり、本問の契約は15か月かかる可能性はあっても1年未満で終わることもあり得るため、この類型に該当しない。物品売買（$500以上）や不動産などの他の類型にも当たらないので、詐欺防止法は適用されず、契約条項は執行できる。詐欺防止法が適用されない以上、責任を追及される側（顧客）の署名があるかどうかを検討する必要もない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.18

questions.stem: A CPA is auditing the financial statements of XYZ Corp. During the audit of XYZ's invoices, the CPA discovers four invoices pertaining to transactions that took place before the end of the year under audit. None of the four invoices have been recorded in XYZ's financial records. Which of the following invoiced transactions requires an accrual of a liability based on the doctrine of substantial performance?

choices.label: A
choices.text: XYZ ordered 100 blue widgets from ABC, but ABC delivered 100 red widgets.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Quick Delivery, Inc. delivered XYZ's inventory to XYZ's retail location #107 but it was supposed to go to location #108, which is five miles away.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A web developer redesigned XYZ's company website but XYZ's president, in good faith, was dissatisfied with the finished redesign.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A copywriter delivered a 1,500-word document for XYZ's advertising brochure that contained seven typographical errors.

questions.explanation:
Under the doctrine of substantial performance, when a party completes the main purpose of the contract (writing a 1,500-word document) their contractual duty is considered complete even though minor details are unfinished (correcting typographical errors). This doctrine prevents parties from withholding payment by claiming breach of contract for minor technicalities. Therefore, XYZ Corp. must accrue the copywriter's invoice as a liability for the year under audit.

In contracts for specific services (web design), there is no substantial performance when the recipient has a good faith belief that the services have not been satisfactorily performed ("A web developer redesigned XYZ's company website but XYZ's president,…"). Therefore, XYZ is not yet obligated to pay even though the main purpose of the contract has been performed. Assessing a satisfactory redesign of a website requires more subjective judgment than for a document with typographical errors.

("XYZ ordered 100 blue widgets from ABC, but ABC delivered 100 red widg…") The substantial performance doctrine does not apply to the sale of goods.

("Quick Delivery, Inc. delivered XYZ's inventory to XYZ's retail locati…") Making a delivery to the wrong address is not substantial performance even if the items were delivered close to the intended location.
questions.explanationJa: 実質的履行の法理では、当事者が契約の主たる目的（1,500語の原稿の執筆）を完了していれば、細部（誤字の修正）が未完成でも契約上の義務は履行されたものとみなされる。したがって、XYZはコピーライターの請求書を監査対象年度の負債として計上しなければならない。ウェブサイトのデザインのような役務では、受け手が誠実に不満足と判断していれば実質的履行は成立せず、XYZはまだ支払義務を負わない。物品売買には実質的履行の法理は適用されず、また届け先を誤った配送は、近い場所であっても実質的履行に当たらない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.19

questions.stem: Which of the following types of mistake will generally make a contract unenforceable and allow it to be rescinded?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A unilateral mistake of fact.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A mutual mistake of fact.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A unilateral mistake of value.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A mutual mistake of value.

questions.explanation:
A voidable contract is one that includes a defect in the contract's formation or terms (mutual mistake). For a mutual mistake to serve as a defense, both parties must have been mistaken about a material fact or assumption that caused them to enter the contract. Therefore, the contract is unenforceable and can be rescinded.

For example, a homeowner enters a contract for a pool to be built at the contractor's standard price based on both parties' belief that the soil is suitable. If the contractor runs into unexpected conditions (a rock bed) that will double the price, then the contract is voidable because of the mutual mistake of fact (the assumption there would be no issues). A court generally will not enforce such a contract because it would cause the contractor to fulfill an unprofitable obligation.

("A unilateral mistake of fact." / "A unilateral mistake of value." / "A mutual mistake of value.") A unilateral mistake (only one party is mistaken) does not make a contract voidable, nor does any mistake in value in the formation of a contract. Courts typically follow the concept of "buyer (or seller) beware" and let parties assume the consequences of a mistake. For example, if the pool contractor had checked the soil and mistakenly determined there was no rock bed even though there was, then the contract would not be voidable.
questions.explanationJa: 双方の錯誤（mutual mistake）を抗弁とするには、両当事者が、契約を結ぶ原因となった重要な事実や前提について錯誤に陥っていなければならない。そのような事実についての双方の錯誤がある契約は取り消し得るものとなり、執行されず合意解除できる。一方、一方の当事者だけが錯誤に陥っている場合（一方的錯誤）や、価値についての錯誤は、契約を取り消し得るものにしない。裁判所は通常「買主（売主）注意せよ」の考え方に従い、そうした錯誤の結果は当事者に負わせる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Contracts Q.20

questions.stem: To which of the following transactions does the common law Statute of Frauds not apply?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Contracts for the sale of real estate

choices.label: B
choices.text: Agreements made in consideration of marriage

choices.label: C
choices.text: Promises to pay the debt of another

choices.label: D
choices.text: Contracts that can be performed within one year

questions.explanation:
The common law Statute of Frauds requires a signed writing only for specific categories of contracts: contracts for an interest in land, contracts made in consideration of marriage, promises to answer for the debt of another (suretyship), promises by an executor to pay estate debts personally, and contracts that by their terms cannot be performed within one year of formation. A contract that can possibly be performed within one year falls outside the one-year provision, so it is enforceable even if oral.

Contracts for the sale of real estate are within the Statute because they transfer an interest in land. Agreements made in consideration of marriage (for example, prenuptial agreements) are expressly within the Statute. Promises to pay the debt of another are suretyship promises and must be evidenced by a writing.
questions.explanationJa:
コモンロー上の詐欺防止法（Statute of Frauds）が書面を要求するのは、土地の権利に関する契約、婚姻を約因とする契約、他人の債務の保証、遺言執行者が遺産債務を個人で負担する約束、成立から1年以内に履行できない契約に限られる。1年以内に履行できる可能性のある契約は対象外なので、口頭でも有効である。

不動産売買契約は土地の権利の移転なので対象。婚姻を約因とする合意（婚前契約など）も明文で対象。他人の債務を支払う約束は保証であり書面が必要。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2013 Recently Released Q.1 (AICPA No. 90201)

questions.stem: Which of the following types of conduct renders a contract void?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Mutual mistake as to facts forming the basis of the contract

choices.label: B
choices.text: Undue influence by a dominant party in a confidential relationship

choices.label: C
choices.text: Duress through physical compulsion

choices.label: D
choices.text: Duress through improper threats

questions.explanation:
Duress by physical compulsion (for example, forcing someone to sign at gunpoint by physically moving the person's hand) means there was no real assent at all, so the resulting contract is void (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §174).

A mutual mistake as to a basic fact makes a contract voidable by the adversely affected party, not void. Undue influence by a dominant party in a confidential relationship makes the contract voidable by the victim. Duress through improper threats (economic or other wrongful threats) makes the contract voidable under §175, because the victim did assent, albeit under pressure.
questions.explanationJa:
物理的強制による強迫（例: 手をつかんで無理やり署名させる）は、そもそも意思表示が存在しないため契約は無効（void）となる（Restatement (Second) of Contracts §174）。

基本的事実に関する双方の錯誤は、不利益を受ける当事者が取り消しうる（voidable）にとどまる。信頼関係にある優位者による不当威圧も取り消しうる契約となる。不当な脅迫による強迫は、圧力下とはいえ同意自体はあるため§175により取り消しうる契約となる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2013 Recently Released Q.23 (AICPA No. 90223)

questions.stem: What type of conduct generally will make a contract voidable?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Fraud in the execution

choices.label: B
choices.text: Fraud in the inducement

choices.label: C
choices.text: Physical coercion

choices.label: D
choices.text: Contracting with a person under guardianship

questions.explanation:
Fraud in the inducement occurs when a party knowingly understands that it is entering into a contract but is induced to do so by a fraudulent misrepresentation about a material fact. The innocent party did assent, so the contract is voidable at that party's option (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §164).

Fraud in the execution (the party is deceived about the very nature of the document being signed) means there was no assent, so the contract is void (§163). Physical coercion is duress by physical compulsion, which also makes the contract void. A contract made with a person under guardianship (a person adjudicated incompetent) is void, not merely voidable.
questions.explanationJa:
誘因の詐欺（fraud in the inducement）とは、契約を締結すること自体は理解しているが、重要な事実についての詐欺的な不実表示によって締結に誘導された場合をいう。被害者は同意しているので、契約は被害者の選択により取り消しうる（voidable）（Restatement (Second) of Contracts §164）。

執行の詐欺（署名する書面の性質そのものを偽られた場合）は同意が存在せず無効（void）（§163）。身体的強制は物理的強迫であり無効。後見下にある者（裁判所に無能力と宣告された者）との契約も、取り消しうるにとどまらず無効となる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2013 Recently Released Q.38 (AICPA No. 90238)

questions.stem: Which of the following contractual assignments is prohibited?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The right to receive royalties

choices.label: B
choices.text: The right to be insured under a liability insurance policy

choices.label: C
choices.text: The right to receive installment payments

choices.label: D
choices.text: The rights under an option contract

questions.explanation:
Contract rights are generally assignable unless the assignment would materially change the duty of the obligor, materially increase the burden or risk imposed on the obligor, or materially impair the obligor's chance of obtaining return performance; is forbidden by statute or public policy; or is validly precluded by the contract (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §317(2)). The right to be insured under a liability insurance policy cannot be assigned without the insurer's consent because the insurer's risk depends on the identity of the insured; substituting a new insured materially changes the risk.

The right to receive royalties and the right to receive installment payments are rights to the payment of money, which are freely assignable. The rights under an option contract are also generally assignable because the obligor's performance does not change based on who exercises the option.
questions.explanationJa:
契約上の権利は原則として譲渡できるが、債務者の義務を実質的に変更する場合、債務者の負担やリスクを実質的に増大させる場合、法令・公序に反する場合、契約で有効に禁止されている場合は譲渡できない（Restatement (Second) of Contracts §317(2)）。賠償責任保険で被保険者となる権利は、保険会社のリスクが被保険者が誰かに左右されるため、保険会社の同意なしには譲渡できない。

ロイヤルティを受け取る権利や割賦代金を受け取る権利は金銭債権であり自由に譲渡できる。オプション契約上の権利も、行使者が誰でも債務者の履行内容は変わらないため、通常は譲渡できる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2015 Recently Released Q.4 (AICPA No. 90804)

questions.stem: Under which of the following circumstances would an assignment of rights under a contract be invalid?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The assignment was made without notice to the obligor.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The assignment was made without the assignor's intent to transfer.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The assignment was made without delivery of an evidentiary document.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The assignment was made without notice to the assignee.

questions.explanation:
An assignment is a manifestation of the assignor's intention to transfer a contract right so that the assignor's right to performance is extinguished and the assignee acquires that right (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §317(1)). Without the assignor's present intent to transfer the right, there is no assignment, so the assignment is invalid.

Notice to the obligor is not required for an assignment to be valid between the assignor and assignee; notice only protects the assignee (the obligor who pays the assignor before notice is discharged). As a general rule no writing or delivery of an evidentiary document is required (§324), although particular statutes may require a writing for some assignments. Notice to the assignee is not an element of a valid assignment.
questions.explanationJa:
債権譲渡とは、譲渡人が契約上の権利を移転し、自らの履行請求権を消滅させて譲受人に取得させる意思の表示である（Restatement (Second) of Contracts §317(1)）。譲渡人に現在の移転の意思が無ければ譲渡は成立せず、無効となる。

債務者への通知は譲渡人・譲受人間の譲渡の有効要件ではなく、譲受人を保護するためのものにすぎない（通知前に譲渡人へ弁済した債務者は免責される）。原則として書面や証拠書類の交付も不要である（§324。個別の法令で書面が必要な場合はある）。譲受人への通知も有効要件ではない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2016 Recently Released Q.1 (AICPA No. null)

questions.stem: Knight signed a lease specifying that, if the $400-per-month rent was not received by the fifth of each month, Knight would owe the landlord $25 as liquidated damages, for every day that the rent was late. In January, Knight failed to pay the rent until the 21st of the month. The landlord insisted that Knight pay $800 because Knight owed $400 for the rent and $400 in late charges. What is most likely to be a court's ruling?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The landlord was entitled to $800 because the lease provided for late charges of $25 per day.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The late charges constituted a penalty because they were excessive.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Knight knowingly and voluntarily signed the lease and must pay the specified late charges.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The landlord was prohibited from including a liquidated damages clause in Knight's lease.

questions.explanation:
A liquidated damages clause is enforceable only if the amount is reasonable in light of the anticipated or actual loss caused by the breach and the difficulty of proving the loss. A term fixing unreasonably large liquidated damages is unenforceable as a penalty (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §356). A charge of $25 per day on $400 monthly rent produced $400 in late charges for a 16-day delay, equal to a full month's rent, which is grossly disproportionate to the landlord's probable loss from late payment. A court would most likely treat the late charges as an unenforceable penalty.

The fact that the lease provides for the charge, or that Knight signed it knowingly and voluntarily, does not make a penalty enforceable. Liquidated damages clauses are not prohibited in leases; they are enforced when the amount is a reasonable estimate of damages.
questions.explanationJa:
損害賠償額の予定条項は、違反により予想される（または実際の）損害と損害立証の困難さに照らして合理的な額である場合に限り有効で、不合理に大きな額は違約罰（penalty）として無効となる（Restatement (Second) of Contracts §356）。月額$400の家賃に1日$25の遅延損害金を課すと、16日の遅れで家賃1か月分に相当する$400となり、支払遅延による家主の損害と比べて著しく過大である。裁判所は遅延損害金を違約罰と判断する可能性が高い。

契約に定めがあることや、Knightが任意に署名したことによって違約罰が有効になるわけではない。賃貸借契約で損害賠償額の予定条項を定めること自体は禁止されておらず、合理的な見積りであれば有効である。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2016 Recently Released Q.4 (AICPA No. null)

questions.stem: Kelly owed Connor $500. Connor agreed to accept Kelly's microwave oven instead of the money. Kelly immediately delivered the oven to Connor. Which of the following terms correctly describes this agreement?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Mutual rescission.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Accord and satisfaction.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Novation.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Material alteration.

questions.explanation:
An accord is an agreement by the obligee to accept a different performance in satisfaction of an existing duty, and satisfaction is the performance of that accord, which discharges the original duty (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §281). Connor agreed to accept the microwave oven instead of the $500 owed (the accord), and Kelly delivered the oven (the satisfaction), discharging the debt.

A mutual rescission is an agreement by both parties to cancel the contract and return to their original positions, not to substitute a different performance. A novation substitutes a new party for an original party to the contract. A material alteration is an unauthorized change in the terms of a written contract.
questions.explanationJa:
和解契約（accord）は、債権者が既存の債務の代わりに別の給付を受け取ることに合意することで、その履行（satisfaction）により元の債務が消滅する（Restatement (Second) of Contracts §281）。Connorは$500の代わりに電子レンジを受け取ることに合意し（accord）、Kellyが引き渡した（satisfaction）ので債務は消滅した。

合意解除（mutual rescission）は双方が契約を解消して原状に戻す合意で、別の給付に置き換えるものではない。更改（novation）は契約当事者を新たな者に入れ替えるものである。重大な改変（material alteration）は書面契約の条項を無断で変更することである。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2016 Recently Released Q.22 (AICPA No. null)

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the parol evidence rule?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It applies only in cases involving an oral contract.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It applies only to subsequent written modifications to a written contract.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It applies to subsequent oral agreements that contradict the terms of a final written agreement.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It applies to prior or contemporaneous oral agreements that contradict the terms of final written agreements.

questions.explanation:
The parol evidence rule provides that when the parties intend a written agreement to be their final (integrated) expression, evidence of prior or contemporaneous oral (or written) agreements may not be introduced to contradict its terms (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §213; UCC §2-202 for sales of goods).

The rule does not apply only to oral contracts; it protects final written agreements. It does not bar evidence of subsequent modifications, whether written or oral, because a later agreement can change the contract after it was made.
questions.explanationJa:
口頭証拠排除の原則（parol evidence rule）は、当事者が最終的な合意として意図した書面契約がある場合、それに矛盾する事前または同時の口頭（または書面）の合意を証拠として持ち出せないとするものである（Restatement (Second) of Contracts §213、物品売買はUCC §2-202）。

口頭契約だけに適用されるわけではなく、保護されるのは最終的な書面契約である。また、契約成立後の変更合意は書面・口頭を問わず排除されないため、事後の修正に適用されるという記述は誤りである。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2017 Recently Released Q.5 (AICPA No. null)

questions.stem: Dunlap contracted to work exclusively for Foster during June for $5,000. On May 31, Foster canceled the contract. Dunlap found another job during June for $3,000. Dunlap filed suit against Foster for breach of contract. Dunlap should recover what amount of compensatory damages?
questions.explanation:
Compensatory damages place the nonbreaching party in the position it would have occupied had the contract been performed (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §347). The nonbreaching party must also mitigate damages, and amounts earned from substitute employment during the contract period reduce the recovery (§350).

Contract price = $5,000
Less earnings from the replacement job in June = ($3,000)
Compensatory damages = $2,000

The $5,000 amount ignores the duty to mitigate, the $8,000 amount adds the replacement earnings instead of subtracting them, and the $3,000 amount is what Dunlap earned elsewhere, not the loss caused by the breach.
questions.explanationJa:
補償的損害賠償は、契約が履行されていたのと同じ状態に非違反当事者を置くためのものである（Restatement (Second) of Contracts §347）。非違反当事者には損害軽減義務があり、契約期間中に代わりの仕事で得た収入は賠償額から差し引かれる（§350）。

契約代金 = $5,000
6月の代わりの仕事の収入 = ($3,000)
補償的損害賠償 = $2,000

$5,000は損害軽減義務を無視した額、$8,000は代わりの収入を差し引かずに加えた額、$3,000は他で得た収入であり契約違反による損失ではない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2017 Recently Released Q.25 (AICPA No. null)

questions.stem: Essex contracted with Green, a general contractor, for Green to pave a road on Essex's property. Green informed Essex that, due to a breakdown of Green's equipment, Green had assigned the contract to Free, who is in the road-paving business. Essex consented to the assignment and Free began work. In the middle of the job, Free stopped work, leaving the road half-completed. Which of the following statements is the best description of the rights and liabilities of the parties?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Essex may sue only Free for breach of contract because Essex's acceptance of the assignment relieved Green of any liability.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Essex may sue only Green for breach of contract because the contract was between Essex and Green.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Essex may sue both Green and Free for breach of contract because both of them are liable on the contract.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Essex may not sue either Green or Free because Essex accepted the assignment.

questions.explanation:
A party who delegates contractual duties remains liable for their performance unless the obligee agrees to a novation releasing the delegating party (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §318(3)). Essex's consent to the assignment is not a novation, so Green remains liable. An assignee who accepts an assignment of the contract and begins performance assumes the delegated duties and becomes liable to the obligee (§328). Free accepted the assignment and began work, so Free is also liable. Essex may therefore sue both Green and Free for breach.

Consenting to an assignment does not, by itself, release the original obligor, so Green is not relieved of liability. Essex is not limited to suing Green, because Free's assumption of the duties makes Free directly liable. Accepting the assignment does not waive Essex's right to complete performance from either party.
questions.explanationJa:
契約上の義務を委任（delegation）した当事者は、債権者が委任者を免責する更改（novation）に同意しない限り、履行の責任を負い続ける（Restatement (Second) of Contracts §318(3)）。Essexが譲渡に同意したことは更改ではないので、Greenは引き続き責任を負う。また、契約の譲渡を受けて履行を開始した譲受人は委任された義務を引き受けたことになり、債権者に直接責任を負う（§328）。Freeは譲渡を受け作業を開始したので、Freeも責任を負う。したがってEssexはGreenとFreeの両方を契約違反で訴えられる。

譲渡に同意しただけでは当初の債務者は免責されないので、Greenが責任を免れるという記述は誤り。Freeは義務を引き受けて直接責任を負うので、Greenだけしか訴えられないという記述も誤り。譲渡を受け入れても、いずれの当事者に完全な履行を求める権利も放棄したことにはならない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2018 Recently Released Q.5 (AICPA No. 57599)

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the formation of a unilateral contract?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A unilateral contract may be formed without consideration.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A unilateral contract does not require performance.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Only one party to a unilateral contract makes a promise.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Only one party to a unilateral contract receives a benefit or suffers a detriment.

questions.explanation:
A unilateral contract is formed when one party (the offeror) makes a promise in exchange for the other party's performance rather than a return promise. Only one party makes a promise; the offeree accepts by performing.

A unilateral contract still requires consideration; the offeree's performance is the bargained-for consideration. Performance is precisely what the offeror requests, so a unilateral contract does require performance. Both parties give something of legal value (the promise and the performance), so it is incorrect that only one party receives a benefit or suffers a detriment.
questions.explanationJa:
片務契約（unilateral contract）は、申込者が相手方の約束ではなく「行為（履行）」と引換えに約束をすることで成立する。約束をするのは一方の当事者だけで、相手方は履行によって承諾する。

片務契約にも約因は必要で、相手方の履行がその約因となる。申込者が求めているのはまさに履行なので、履行を要しないという文言は誤り。双方が法的価値のあるもの（約束と履行）を提供するので、一方だけが利益を受け、または不利益を被るという文言も誤り。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2019 Recently Released Q.26 (AICPA No. 60073)

questions.stem: If a party to a contract engages in an anticipatory repudiation of the contract, which of the following statements is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The repudiation is a material breach of the contract.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The repudiating party cannot retract the anticipatory repudiation.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The other party never has a duty to mitigate any losses resulting from the repudiation.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The other party cannot take action against the repudiating party until the time for performance has passed and performance has not occurred.

questions.explanation:
An anticipatory repudiation is a definite and unequivocal statement, before performance is due, that a party will not perform. A repudiation of a material obligation is treated as a total (material) breach that gives the non-repudiating party an immediate claim for damages (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §253).

The repudiating party may retract the repudiation until the other party materially changes position in reliance on it or indicates that it considers the repudiation final (§256), so it is not true that the repudiation cannot be retracted. The non-repudiating party has a duty to mitigate damages and cannot recover losses it could have avoided without undue risk or burden (§350). The non-repudiating party may sue immediately, before the time for performance has passed.
questions.explanationJa:
履行期前の履行拒絶（anticipatory repudiation）は、履行期到来前に履行しない旨を明確に表明することである。重要な債務の履行拒絶は全部（重大な）違反として扱われ、相手方は直ちに損害賠償を請求できる（契約法第2リステイトメント §253）。

拒絶した当事者は、相手方がそれを信頼して立場を実質的に変更するか、拒絶を確定的なものと扱う旨を示すまでは撤回できる（§256）ので、撤回できないとする記述は誤り。相手方には損害軽減義務があり、避けられた損失は回復できない（§350）。また、相手方は履行期の経過を待たずに直ちに訴えることができる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2020 Recently Released Part2 Q.27 (AICPA No. 91174)

questions.stem: A business entered into a contract with a construction company to remodel the office of the business. The contract called for the remodeling to be completed by October 1, year 1. On July 1, year 1, the construction company sent an email to the business informing the business that it will not finish the job. What recourse does the business have?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The business can consider the construction company to be in breach of contract on July 1, year 1, and immediately seek remedies.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The business can consider the construction company to be in breach on July 1, year 1, but cannot seek remedies until October 1, year 1.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The business cannot consider the construction company to be in breach of contract until October 1, year 1, and may not seek any remedies until then.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The business must notify the construction company on or after July 1, year 1, of its intent to hold the contractor in breach, and the contractor has 30 days to respond before the contract is breached.

questions.explanation:
The construction company's July 1 email stating that it will not finish the job is a clear and unequivocal anticipatory repudiation (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §250). A repudiation before performance is due gives the non-repudiating party a claim for damages for total breach immediately (§253). The business may treat the contract as breached on July 1 and immediately seek remedies, such as hiring another contractor and suing for damages.

The business is not required to hold off until the October 1 completion date to treat the repudiation as a breach or to seek remedies. There is no requirement that the business give notice of its intent to hold the contractor in breach and then allow 30 days for a response before the breach occurs.
questions.explanationJa:
7月1日に工事を完了しないと伝えた建設会社のメールは、明確な履行期前の履行拒絶（anticipatory repudiation）である（契約法第2リステイトメント §250）。履行期前の拒絶があれば、相手方は直ちに全部違反として損害賠償を請求できる（§253）。会社は7月1日時点で契約違反とみなし、別の業者に依頼して損害賠償を請求するなど、直ちに救済を求めることができる。

違反とみなすことも救済を求めることも、10月1日の完了期限まで待つ必要はない。違反とする意思を通知して30日間の回答期間を置かなければならないというルールもない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2021 Recently Released Q.23 (AICPA No. 82542)

questions.stem: Carson Corp., a retail chain, asked Alto Construction to fix a broken window at one of Carson's stores. Alto offered to make the repairs within three days at a price to be agreed on after the work was completed. A contract based on Alto's offer would fail because of indefiniteness as to the

choices.label: A
choices.text: Price involved

choices.label: B
choices.text: Nature of the subject matter

choices.label: C
choices.text: Parties to the contract

choices.label: D
choices.text: Time for performance

questions.explanation: An offer must be reasonably certain in its essential terms so that a court can determine whether a breach occurred and fashion a remedy (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §33). Alto's offer leaves the price 'to be agreed on after the work was completed,' which is a mere agreement to agree on an essential term, so the price is indefinite. The nature of the subject matter is definite because the offer identifies the specific work: repairing a broken window at one of Carson's stores. The parties to the contract are definite because Carson and Alto are both identified. The time for performance is definite because Alto offered to complete the repairs within three days.
questions.explanationJa: 申込みは、違反の有無を判断し救済を与えられる程度に、重要な条件が確定していなければなりません。Alto の申込みは代金を「作業完了後に合意する」としており、重要条件である価格について合意を先送りしているため、価格の点で不確定です。対象（店舗の割れた窓の修理）、当事者（Carson と Alto）、履行期（3日以内）はいずれも申込みの中で特定されているため、不確定とはいえません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Contracts Q.1

questions.stem: On September 10, Harris, Inc., a new car dealer, placed a newspaper advertisement stating that Harris would sell 10 cars at its showroom for a special discount only on September 12, 13, and 14. On September 12, King called Harris and expressed an interest in buying one of the advertised cars. King was told that five of the cars had been sold and to come to the showroom as soon as possible. On September 13, Harris made a televised announcement that the sale would end at 10:00 p.m. that night. King went to Harris' showroom on September 14 and demanded the right to buy a car at the special discount. Harris had sold the 10 cars and refused King's demand. King sued Harris for breach of contract. Harris' best defense to King's suit would be that Harris'

choices.label: A
choices.text: Offer was unenforceable.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Advertisement was not an offer.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Television announcement revoked the offer.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Offer had not been accepted.

questions.explanation: Advertisements directed to the general public are ordinarily treated as invitations to negotiate rather than offers, because they do not show an intent to be bound to every person who responds (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §26). Harris' ad named only a 'special discount,' not a specific price for specific cars, so it lacked the definite terms of an offer. Because there was never an offer, King had nothing to accept, and that is Harris' strongest defense. Arguing that the offer was unenforceable, that the television announcement revoked the offer, or that the offer had not been accepted all concede that an offer existed; each of those is a weaker defense than showing that no offer was ever made.
questions.explanationJa: 一般大衆向けの広告は、応じた者すべてに拘束される意思を示していないため、通常は申込みではなく「申込みの誘引」にとどまります。Harris の広告は「特別割引」と述べるだけで、特定の車の具体的な価格を示しておらず、申込みとしての確定性もありません。申込みが存在しなければ King が承諾する対象もないため、これが最も強い抗弁です。「申込みは強制できない」「テレビの告知で申込みは撤回された」「申込みは承諾されていない」という主張は、いずれも申込みが存在したことを前提にしており、申込み自体がなかったという抗弁より弱くなります。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Contracts Q.2

questions.stem: On June 15, Peters orally offered to sell a used lawn mower to Mason for $125. Peters specified that Mason had until June 20 to accept the offer. On June 16, Peters received an offer to purchase the lawn mower for $150 from Bronson, Mason's neighbor. Peters accepted Bronson's offer. On June 17, Mason saw Bronson using the lawn mower and was told the mower had been sold to Bronson. Mason immediately wrote to Peters to accept the June 15 offer. Which of the following statements is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Mason's acceptance would be effective when received by Peters.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Mason's acceptance would be effective when mailed.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Peters' offer had been revoked and Mason's acceptance was ineffective.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Peters was obligated to keep the June 15 offer open until June 20.

questions.explanation: An offer is revoked indirectly when the offeror takes definite action inconsistent with an intention to enter into the proposed contract and the offeree acquires reliable information of that action (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §43). Peters sold the mower to Bronson, and Mason learned of the sale on June 17 before attempting to accept, so the offer was revoked and Mason's later acceptance had no effect. Whether the acceptance would be effective when received by Peters or when mailed does not matter, because there was no longer an offer to accept. Peters was not obligated to keep the June 15 offer open until June 20 because Mason gave no consideration for that promise, and the firm-offer rule of UCC §2-205 requires a signed writing by a merchant, whereas this offer was oral.
questions.explanationJa: 申込者が契約の意思と相いれない行為をし、被申込者がその事実を信頼できる情報として知った場合、申込みは間接的に撤回されます。Peters は芝刈り機を Bronson に売却し、Mason は承諾の手紙を出す前の6月17日にその事実を知ったため、申込みは撤回済みで、Mason の承諾は効力を持ちません。承諾が到達時に効力を生じるか発信時に効力を生じるかは、承諾すべき申込みが残っていないので問題になりません。また、6月20日まで申込みを維持すると約束しても、Mason が対価を与えていないため拘束力はなく、UCC の確定申込み（firm offer）は商人の署名入り書面が必要なので口頭の申込みには適用されません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Contracts Q.3

questions.stem: On June 15, Year 1, Alpha, Inc. contracted with Delta Manufacturing, Inc. to buy a vacant parcel of land Delta owned. Alpha intended to build a distribution warehouse on the land because of its location near a major highway. The contract stated that: "Alpha's obligations hereunder are subject to the vacant parcel being rezoned to a commercial zoning classification by July 31, Year 2." Which of the following statements is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: If the parcel is not rezoned by July 31, and Alpha refuses to purchase it, Alpha would not be in breach of contract.

choices.label: B
choices.text: If the parcel is rezoned by July 31, and Alpha refuses to purchase it, Delta would be able to successfully sue Alpha for specific performance.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The contract is not binding on either party because Alpha's performance is conditional.

choices.label: D
choices.text: If the parcel is rezoned by July 31, and Delta refuses to sell it, Delta's breach would not discharge Alpha's obligation to tender payment.

questions.explanation: Rezoning by July 31, Year 2 is a condition precedent to Alpha's duty to buy. If a condition precedent does not occur, the conditioned party's duty never becomes due, so Alpha's refusal to purchase an unrezoned parcel is not a breach (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§224-225). The claim that Delta would be able to successfully sue Alpha for specific performance fails because specific performance is an equitable remedy granted only when money damages are inadequate; Delta, as seller, wants only the purchase price, so money damages give Delta an adequate remedy, whereas a buyer of unique land is the party who typically obtains specific performance. The contract is binding even though Alpha's performance is conditional: a conditional promise is still a valid promise that becomes enforceable when the condition occurs. If the parcel is rezoned and Delta refuses to sell, Delta's material breach discharges Alpha's obligation to tender payment, so the statement that it would not discharge that obligation is incorrect.
questions.explanationJa: 7月31日（Year 2）までの用途変更（rezoning）は、Alpha の購入義務の停止条件（condition precedent）です。条件が成就しなければ Alpha の義務は発生しないため、用途変更されていない土地の購入を拒んでも契約違反にはなりません。Delta が Alpha に特定履行を求めて勝訴できるという記述は誤りで、特定履行は金銭賠償では不十分な場合に限られる衡平法上の救済です。売主の Delta が求めるのは代金なので金銭賠償で足り、特定履行を得るのは通常、唯一性のある土地を買う側です。また、Alpha の履行が条件付きでも契約は有効で、条件が成就すれば拘束力が生じます。用途変更後に Delta が売却を拒めば、その重大な違反により Alpha の代金提供義務は消滅するため、「消滅しない」とする記述も誤りです。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Contracts Q.4

questions.stem: On February 12, Harris sent Fresno a written offer to purchase Fresno's land. The offer included the following provision: "Acceptance of this offer must be by registered or certified mail, received by Harris no later than February 18 by 5:00 p.m. CST." On February 18, Fresno sent Harris a letter accepting the offer by private overnight delivery service. Harris received the letter on February 19. Which of the following statements is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A contract was formed on February 19.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Fresno's letter constituted a counteroffer.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Fresno's use of the overnight delivery service was an effective form of acceptance.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A contract was formed on February 18 regardless of when Harris actually received Fresno's letter.

questions.explanation: The offeror is the master of the offer. Harris required acceptance by registered or certified mail and required that it be received by 5:00 p.m. on February 18. Fresno used a different method, and the letter arrived on February 19, after the offer had lapsed by its own terms. An attempted acceptance made after the offer has terminated cannot create a contract; at most it operates as a new offer, that is, a counteroffer that Harris may accept or reject (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§41, 60, 70). A contract was not formed on February 19 because receipt after the deadline does not revive the expired offer. Fresno's use of the overnight delivery service was not an effective form of acceptance because it did not follow the method the offer stipulated. A contract was not formed on February 18 on dispatch because the mailbox rule does not apply when the offer expressly requires receipt by a stated time.
questions.explanationJa: 申込者は申込みの条件を自由に定められます。Harris は書留または配達証明郵便による承諾と、2月18日午後5時までの到達を条件にしていました。Fresno は指定と異なる方法を使い、手紙は申込みの期限が切れた2月19日に届いたため、契約は成立せず、その手紙は Harris が受けるか拒むかを選べる新たな申込み（反対申込み）にとどまります。期限後の到達で失効した申込みが復活することはないので、2月19日に契約は成立しません。翌日配達便の利用は申込みで指定された方法に従っていないため、有効な承諾方法ではありません。到達を条件とする申込みには発信主義（mailbox rule）が適用されないため、受領日にかかわらず2月18日に契約が成立したともいえません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Contracts Q.5

questions.stem:
In negotiations with Andrews for the lease of Kemp's warehouse, Kemp orally agreed to pay one-half of the cost of the utilities. The written lease, later prepared by Kemp's attorney, provided that Andrews pay all of the utilities. Andrews failed to carefully read the lease and signed it. When Kemp demanded that Andrews pay all of the utilities, Andrews refused, claiming that the lease did not accurately reflect the oral agreement. Andrews also learned that Kemp intentionally misrepresented the condition of the structure of the warehouse during the negotiations between the parties. Andrews sued to rescind the lease and intends to introduce evidence of the parties' oral agreement about sharing the utilities and the fraudulent statements made by Kemp. The parol evidence rule will prevent the admission of evidence concerning the

Oral agreement on who pays utilities | Fraudulent statements by Kemp

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes | Yes

choices.label: B
choices.text: No | Yes

choices.label: C
choices.text: Yes | No

choices.label: D
choices.text: No | No

questions.explanation: The parol evidence rule bars evidence of prior or contemporaneous oral agreements offered to vary or contradict the terms of a final written agreement (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §213). Kemp's oral promise to pay half of the utilities was made during negotiations and contradicts the signed lease, which places all utilities on Andrews, so evidence of that oral agreement is excluded; Andrews' failure to read the lease does not change this. The rule does not exclude evidence offered to show that the writing is invalid or voidable, such as evidence of fraud (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §214(d)). Kemp's intentional misrepresentation about the warehouse's structure is offered to rescind the lease for fraud, so that evidence is admissible.
questions.explanationJa: 口頭証拠排除の原則（parol evidence rule）は、最終的な書面契約の内容を変更・矛盾させる目的で、契約締結前または同時の口頭合意を証拠とすることを禁じます。光熱費を半分負担するという Kemp の口頭の約束は交渉中のもので、光熱費を全額 Andrews の負担とした署名済みの賃貸借契約と矛盾するため、証拠として排除されます（Andrews が契約書をよく読まなかったことは結論を変えません）。一方、詐欺など契約の無効・取消しを示すための証拠はこの原則で排除されません。倉庫の構造に関する Kemp の故意の不実表示は、詐欺による契約取消しを求める証拠なので提出できます。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Contracts Q.6

questions.stem: West, an Indiana real estate broker, misrepresented to Zimmer that West was licensed in Kansas under the Kansas statute that regulates real estate brokers and requires all brokers to be licensed. Zimmer signed a contract agreeing to pay West a 5% commission for selling Zimmer's home in Kansas. West did not sign the contract. West sold Zimmer's home. If West sued Zimmer for nonpayment of commission, Zimmer would be

choices.label: A
choices.text: Liable to West only for the value of services rendered

choices.label: B
choices.text: Liable to West for the full commission

choices.label: C
choices.text: Not liable to West for any amount because West did not sign the contract

choices.label: D
choices.text: Not liable to West for any amount because West violated the Kansas licensing requirements

questions.explanation: When a licensing statute is regulatory, meaning it is designed to protect the public from unqualified practitioners, a contract by an unlicensed person to perform the regulated services is unenforceable on grounds of public policy, and the unlicensed person generally cannot recover even in quasi-contract (Restatement (Second) of Contracts §181). The Kansas statute regulates real estate brokers, and West was not licensed in Kansas, so West can recover nothing. Liability only for the value of services rendered would let West recover in quasi-contract, which courts deny to unlicensed parties under a regulatory statute. Liability for the full commission would enforce an illegal bargain. West's failure to sign the contract is not the reason Zimmer escapes liability: the statute of frauds requires the signature of the party to be charged, which is Zimmer, and Zimmer signed.
questions.explanationJa: 免許制度が公衆保護を目的とする規制目的（regulatory）のものである場合、無免許者が規制対象の役務を提供する契約は公序に反して強制できず、無免許者は準契約に基づく請求（役務の価値相当額）も原則として認められません。カンザス州の法律は不動産仲介業者を規制するもので、West はカンザス州の免許を持っていないため、何も回収できません。「役務の価値相当額だけ責任を負う」は準契約による回収を認めることになり、規制目的の免許違反では否定されます。「手数料全額の責任を負う」は違法な取引を強制することになります。また、詐欺防止法で署名が必要なのは責任を問われる側（Zimmer）であり、Zimmer は署名しているため、West が署名していないことは責任を免れる理由になりません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Contracts Q.7

questions.stem: Kay, an art collector, promised Hammer, an art student, that if Hammer could obtain certain rare artifacts within two weeks, Kay would pay for Hammer's post-graduate education.
